exposure: Maternal spina bifida vs no birth defects
outcome: Intensive care unit admission during delivery hospitalization
cohort: 397 pregnant women with spina bifida and 1,083,211 pregnant women without spina bifida who delivered infants in hospitals in Quebec, Canada, 1989-2013
finding: Women with spina bifida had an increased risk of several adverse maternal and infant outcomes at delivery, including intensive care unit admission, respiratory morbidity, intracranial hemorrhage, and birth hypoxia.
